parts.t: Neighbourhood guide · City of Surrey · Guildford

Fraser Heights is an MLS® area in northeast Surrey. The City describes the Fraser Heights area as running from the South Fraser Perimeter Road and the Fraser River in the north down to Highway 1 in the south, with Surrey Bend Regional Park next to it on the Fraser River, in the northeast corner of the city. On the MLS® map, the south edge on 160 Street is around 102 to 104 Avenue.

Written by Jared Gibbons, REALTOR®, Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, on October 13, 2026. I have worked in Fraser Valley real estate for 11+ years. Facts come from the official sources noted on this page. Rules and boundaries change, so confirm anything important with the City of Surrey and Surrey Schools.
Not legal, planning or financial advice. Confirm zoning, plan designations and school catchments before you buy or sell.

The Abbey Ridge plan covers East Fraser Heights. Council approved it on February 6, 2017. The City says the newer Surrey 2050 Official Community Plan has replaced its land use designations, but the plan still guides parks and services.
The City says East Fraser Heights started out as suburban acreage lots, with industrial land along the Golden Ears Connector.

Fraser Heights is an MLS® area name in Surrey. On the MLS® map it runs in northeast Surrey toward the Fraser River. On 160 Street its south edge is around 102 to 104 Avenue, and south of 110 Avenue its west edge is east of about 152 Street. These edges are approximate and are not an official City boundary, so ask me if a specific address is in it.
